Job Overview

We are looking for a curious and hands-on AI Engineer to build, deploy, and operate AI solutions for enterprise customers in regulated industries. In this role, you will build AI agents and LLM-powered applications, connect them to enterprise data and systems, and take them from prototype to production on on-premise infrastructure.

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic engineer with strong applied AI skills who enjoys solving real business problems. You should be comfortable understanding a problem, designing an agent-based or LLM-driven solution, and deploying it to run reliably in production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Problem Understanding: Understand business problems, clarify requirements and success criteria, and propose a practical AI-driven approach.

  • Agent Development: Build and configure AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning, planning and tool use, using agent harnesses and frameworks.

  • Tools & MCP Integration: Build custom tools, skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that let agents interact with APIs, databases and internal systems.

  • Applied AI & RAG: Build LLM-powered applications and RAG pipelines. Optimise prompts, retrieval and context to improve the accuracy and reliability of outputs.

  • Evaluation & Optimisation: Test and evaluate agent and LLM outputs, then improve accuracy, latency and cost across models and workflows.

  • Deployment & Operations: Deploy and operate models and AI services on on-premise infrastructure using Linux, Docker and Kubernetes. Monitor performance, troubleshoot issues and keep services reliable.

  • Data Integration: Connect data sources, build data pipelines, and prepare data for retrieval, analytics and AI use cases.

  • Delivery Ownership: Own assigned workstreams from proof-of-concept to production: plan tasks, manage timelines and flag risks early.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI, IT or a related field. (Fresh graduates to 3 years of experience; high-potential fresh graduates are welcome.)

  • Applied AI: Hands-on experience building with LLMs through final year projects, internships, side projects or hackathons, with a working understanding of prompt engineering, tool/function calling, RAG and AI agents.

  • Programming: Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go or TypeScript (Node.js), with Git for version control.

  • Linux & Containers: Solid working knowledge of Linux environments (CLI) and hands-on experience containerising and running applications with Docker.

  • Ownership: Takes ownership of problems end to end, from understanding the need to delivering a working result, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

  • Language: Proficient in written and spoken English.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Production AI Delivery: Experience delivering production-ready AI projects across the full software development life cycle (SDLC), from design and development through testing and deployment.

  • Agent Frameworks & MCP: Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, and building MCP servers.

  • RAG Pipelines: Familiarity with document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector databases and rerankers.

  • Model Serving: Experience with vLLM, Ollama or similar model-serving tools.

  • Orchestration: Exposure to Kubernetes or deployments in on-premise / private cloud environments.

  • Data: SQL skills and experience building data pipelines.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Able to explain technical work clearly to non-technical stakeholders, present demos and gather requirements.

Who is Artefact?

Artefact is a global consulting firm specialising in Data & AI, dedicated to transforming data into measurable business impact. We combine business consulting with deep expertise in data, AI, analytics, and technology to help organisations accelerate their transformation.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together consultants, data scientists, data engineers, AI engineers, and technology experts to deliver impactful solutions for leading organisations around the world.

As we continue to grow our Data & AI capabilities in Southeast Asia, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join our team in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

About the Role

As an AI Engineer, you will be a hands-on builder, working on the design, development, and deployment of AI and Generative AI solutions for our clients.

You will work within multidisciplinary teams and collaborate directly with client stakeholders to transform business challenges and ideas into practical, scalable AI solutions.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build & Deploy AI Solutions: Design, prototype, test, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, from PoCs through to production.

  • Generative AI & LLMs: Develop solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, AI agents, and other emerging GenAI capabilities.

  • Cloud & AI Engineering: Build and deploy solutions using GCP, Azure, or AWS, including cloud-native AI services and data pipelines.

  • Solution Development: Contribute to the architecture and development of scalable, secure, and maintainable AI solutions.

  • Productionisation: Support deployment, monitoring, optimisation, and integration of AI solutions into client environments.

  • Client Collaboration: Work with business and technology stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

  • Continuous Innovation: Keep up with developments across AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, MLOps/LLMOps, and cloud technologies and apply them to real business use cases.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, AI/Machine Learning, or another relevant technical field.

  • Professional experience in AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical role.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with SQL.

  • Hands-on experience developing Machine Learning and/or Generative AI solutions.

  • Experience with LLM-related technologies such as RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, vector databases, or AI agents.

  • Familiarity with ML/AI frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, or equivalent.

  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform: GCP, Azure, or AWS.

  • Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery.

  • Previous experience working in a consulting or client-facing environment.

Why Join Artefact?

Work at the forefront of AI. Build real-world solutions using Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and emerging technologies.

  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning and agent-based AI systems.
  • Experience with real-time streaming architectures (Kafka, Ray, or similar).
  • Experience in leveraging structured and semi-structured data for improving LLM-generated outputs.

Adopting for Reading Assessment

Benchmarking

The CompanyOneCredit is Malaysia's newest credit bureau, registered under the Ministry of Finance. We turn credit and business data into insights that help banks and businesses manage risk and make better decisions.

The RoleWe're hiring an AI Product Manager to own product direction for our Data & AI portfolio: live products spanning financial document extraction, litigation intelligence, relationship mapping, credit scoring, company classification, lead generation and expanding data sources across a team of 10+ Data Scientists/Machine Learning Engineers/Data Engineers.

This is a product role, not project coordination. You decide what we build and why, talk to bank and enterprise customers directly, and hold the team to outcomes. You also own how the team plans and prioritizes work across the portfolio.

Our products are LLM and ML systems. The roadmap is only as good as your understanding of what today's models can and can't do for our use cases, and where they're heading next. You'll lead how we define and measure quality for every product.

  • Own the roadmap for our key products: problem statements, success metrics, scope, and what we don't build

  • Spot new products as new data sources come online, and make the case for which to build
